description: Verify a JWT signature and its exp/nbf window. key is the shared secret for HS256/384/512, or for RS/PS/ES/EdDSA a PEM public key or certificate, a public JWK, or a whole JWKS (picked by the token kid). Rejects alg "none" and HS tokens checked with a public key (algorithm confusion). Does not check iss or aud.

algorithms.description: Allowed algorithms, e.g. ["RS256"]; any other alg fails

clock_tolerance_sec.description: Leeway for exp and nbf in seconds (default 0)

key.description: HMAC secret, PEM public key/certificate, JWK JSON, or JWKS JSON

secret_encoding.description: How an HMAC secret is encoded (default utf8)

name: verify_jwt
